<div class="toolbox-kind">Resource · first-pass decision guide</div>

## Define the request

Record these before searching a catalog:

- area of interest and acceptable number of scenes/passes;
- target date or range and temporal tolerance;
- maximum useful cloud cover;
- required spatial and temporal resolution;
- measurement: true color, surface temperature, water vapor, active fire or another product;
- whether analysis-ready surface products are required.

## Candidate families

| Need | Start investigating |
|---|---|
| Medium-resolution land imagery and true color | Sentinel-2 / Copernicus |
| Frequent, coarser global land or atmosphere observations | MODIS on Terra/Aqua |
| Fire and other thematic Earth-observation products | NASA Earthdata product catalogs |
| Radar unaffected by cloud cover | Sentinel-1 / Copernicus |

This is a routing table, not a product guarantee. Product identifiers, catalog links, coverage and processing levels must be checked against current official documentation before use. Verified links and a fuller decision table are tracked in the [roadmap](../ROADMAP.md).

After acquisition, use the [raster reference](../snippets/raster.qmd) for inspection, crop/mask, calculations and export.
